news_candidates.title: Anthropic Set to Expand Pre-IPO Credit Facility
news_candidates.title_zh: Anthropic拟扩大IPO前循环信贷额度
news_candidates.summary: Anthropic PBC is set to finalize an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, clearing a hurdle before the artificial intelligence firm’s public filing for its highly anticipated IPO. Morgan Stanley is leading the process, the people said. Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and JPMorgan Chase & Co. also have prominent roles on the facility, along with Citigroup Inc., they said. The four lenders are also leading the IPO, Bloomberg News has reported. The Claude chatbot maker is seeking to raise as much as SpaceX or more in the initial public offering, people familiar with the preparations have said. Companies typically finalize the revolver before they notify banks of their formal roles in a listing. For more, we speak with Bailey Lipschultz, Senior Equities Reporter for Bloomberg News. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: 知情人士称，Anthropic PBC拟将循环信贷额度扩大至150亿美元，为备受期待的IPO公开申报扫清一项障碍。摩根士丹利牵头，高盛、摩根大通和花旗也参与，并共同主导IPO。

news_candidates.title: How AI Is Eroding the First Rung of the Tech Job Ladder
news_candidates.title_zh: 美国信息行业8月减少约2.3万个岗位
news_candidates.summary: The US information sector shed roughly 23,000 jobs in August, offering another potential signal of how AI is reshaping the labor market. Northeastern University Professor Alicia Modestino discusses why tech may be the “canary in the coal mine,” with her research showing a decline in junior versus senior software developer vacancies since ChatGPT’s release. She also discusses why employers are demanding more experience, judgment and human-centric skills from entry-level workers. She joins Bloomberg’s Lisa Mateo on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

news_candidates.title_zh: 英国汽油价格升至伊朗战争开始以来最高水平
news_candidates.summary: The price of unleaded hits 163p a litre, according to motoring group the RAC, as oil prices remain elevated.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 英国汽车协会RAC称，无铅汽油价格升至每升163便士，因油价仍处于高位。

news_candidates.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
news_candidates.title_zh: 泽连斯基称俄罗斯无人机袭击乌克兰安全部门总部
news_candidates.summary: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 泽连斯基称，无人机在毫无预警的情况下袭击了乌克兰首都中心地区。

news_candidates.title: Hedge Funds Hike Bullish Oil Bets to May High as Iran War Flares
news_candidates.title_zh: 伊朗战争升温，对冲基金将看涨原油押注增至5月以来高位
news_candidates.summary: Hedge funds turned the most bullish on Brent crude since May as a fresh spate of fighting between the US and Iran heightened concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 美伊新一轮战事加剧了市场对霍尔木兹海峡能源流动长期受扰的担忧，对冲基金对布伦特原油的看涨程度升至5月以来最高。

news_candidates.title: Private equity faces existential crisis in US as unsold companies pile up
news_candidates.title_zh: 未售出公司不断积压，美国私募股权面临生存危机
news_candidates.summary: Private equity firms and the companies they own employ over 13 million, from startups to rural hospitals and large retailers, but experts’ concerns of collapse are growing Retail stalwarts Saks and Eddie Bauer filed for bankruptcy. Kmart and JoAnn Fabrics are gone for good, a trail of layoffs and disappointed customers in their wake. Hospital giant Steward Health Care collapsed, costing thousands of jobs and leaving several communities without a local hospital. These once-trusted US companies have one thing in common: they were owned by private equity investors, who load companies with debt when they buy them and squeeze out profits as they restructure. Continue reading...
news_candidates.summary_zh: 私募股权公司及其持有企业雇佣逾1300万人，涵盖初创企业、乡村医院和大型零售商。专家对其崩溃的担忧加剧，称其收购后常令企业负债并在重组中提取利润。

news_candidates.title: China’s 26% Earnings Boom Lands With a Thud in the Stock Market
news_candidates.title_zh: 中国26%的盈利增长未能提振股市
news_candidates.summary: China’s best profit growth in five years hasn’t been enough to reignite a stock rally, with a weak economy and doubts over AI returns sapping investor enthusiasm.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 中国录得五年来最强利润增长，但疲弱经济及对AI回报的疑虑削弱投资者热情，未能重燃股市涨势。

news_candidates.title: Ayako Yoshioka Discusses Tech’s Impact on Inflation and Prices
news_candidates.title_zh: 绫子·吉冈讨论科技对通胀和价格的影响
news_candidates.summary: Ayako Yoshioka, a Senior Investment Strategist at Wealth Enhancement Group, joins the show to discuss technology’s role in the inflation outlook. The segment frames a client conversation around whether technology could help stoke inflation in the near term or, alternatively, contribute to lower prices and cost relief for the broader economy over time. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: Wealth Enhancement Group高级投资策略师绫子·吉冈讨论科技在通胀前景中的作用：科技近期可能推升通胀，或长期推动价格下降并为整体经济带来成本缓解。

news_candidates.title: U.S. sanctions Turkish bank accused of enabling Iran as Bessent says he 'hopes for' no further bank penalties
news_candidates.title_zh: 美国制裁被指协助伊朗的土耳其银行
news_candidates.summary: President Donald Trump hyped the sanctions plan as "economic D-Day" against Iran, but the U.S. has so far taken few steps to implement it.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 美国对一家被指协助伊朗的土耳其银行实施制裁。报道同时称，美国迄今对其所称制裁计划采取的实施步骤有限。

news_candidates.title: Brazil Sees Double-Digit Export Jump to US Despite Trump Tariffs
news_candidates.title_zh: 尽管特朗普加征关税，巴西对美出口仍实现两位数增长
news_candidates.summary: Brazil posted a bigger-than-expected trade surplus in August, helped by a jump in exports to the US despite a full month of President Donald Trump’s 25% tariffs.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 巴西8月贸易顺差高于预期，得益于对美国出口增长，尽管特朗普总统征收25%关税已满一个月。

news_candidates.title: U.S. 'Economic Outcast’ operation gains momentum as EU joins sanctions; South Korea weighs military backing
news_candidates.title_zh: 欧盟加入对伊制裁，韩国考虑支持重开霍尔木兹海峡
news_candidates.summary: The EU formally joined the U.S.-led sanctions campaign against Iran, while South Korea said it's weighing a military role to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 欧盟正式加入美国主导的对伊朗制裁行动；韩国表示正考虑承担军事角色，以协助重开霍尔木兹海峡。

news_candidates.title: ‘Nothing But Headaches’: Vermont Businesses Decry Canada Tariffs
news_candidates.title_zh: “只有麻烦”：佛蒙特州企业谴责对加拿大关税
news_candidates.summary: They went to the podium, one after another — a ski-resort operator, a cheesemaker, a man who sells snow-grooming equipment and more. Each had the same plea: end the trade war with Canada. It’s hurting our business.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 滑雪场经营者、奶酪制造商和售卖压雪设备的商人等接连呼吁结束与加拿大的贸易战，称其正损害企业经营。
